text:
incident-bot: ALERT: PagerDuty incident fired for service:redwood-hosted-api (high 5xx rate). Severity: P1. Escalation policy: on-call -> secondary -> manager. Page ID: PD-98765

pagerduty: Notification: Page PD-98765 routed to oncall-amy, secondary: sanjay, manager: manager-julie.  Dispatched via SMS and push.

oncall-amy: saw it, acking now. digging into logs. can someone pull the last 30s error spikes? :eyes:

sanjay: i'm on mobile, getting into console. looks like 502 spikes from the hosted frontends.

megan: checking release windows — we had a config rollout 12m ago that touched the gateway routing. rolling that back is an option if we confirm.

oncall-amy: grabbing nginx upstream logs now. initial hypothesis: a new backend pool health check flapping, frontends returning 502.

incident-bot: PD: PD-98765 escalated to secondary after 5m unack by primary. (automated)

oncall-amy: ack. saw a brief blip in k8s cluster autoscaler too, lots of pod restarts on model-serving pods. collecting pod logs:```kubectl -n serving logs -l app=llm-proxy --since=2m```

sanjay: logs show: `backend error: upstream response timeout` repeated across pods. latency on model runtime jumped ~6-7s. Could be a GPU host flake.

megan: i'm checking infra metrics — one host in shard eu-west-1 shows network drops in the last 4m. opening host-level incident. tagging infra oncall.

oncall-amy: customer-impact: some hosted inference requests are returning 502/504 intermittently; estimate ~2-3% of traffic in the last 10m. posting a short status update.

manager-julie: are we paging manager now? how severe for enterprise customers?

megan: PD escalated to manager per policy because secondary hasn't confirmed mitigation. we've got enterprise sessions hitting errors; a few support tickets coming in. recommending manual fallback to cached model variants and enabling extra retry logic at the edge.

oncall-amy: doing immediate mitigation: 1) remove the flaky backend from LB pool 2) enable edge retries with backoff 3) deploy temporary rate limit to reduce retries amplifying load.

sanjay: removing pod node from service group. command:```kubectl patch svc model-backend -p '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Cluster"}}'``` (will reroute)

incident-bot: PD: Manager Julie notified via call. Escalation confirmed.

oncall-amy: removed host from pool, seeing error rate drop in the frontends. 5xx down from 3% -> 0.8% in 3m. still monitoring.

megan: infra team reports NIC flaps on host eu-west-1-12. they're isolating and will reprovision.

manager-julie: thanks — keep me posted. please open a postmortem ticket and include timeline + customer impact + rollback trigger thresholds.

megan: creating incident ticket: INC-2026-042 with preliminary notes and action items. adding ops, infra, and devex.

oncall-amy: will follow up with a short status page update to customers: "We experienced intermittent API errors affecting a subset of requests; a mitigation is in place and we're monitoring. Root cause under investigation."

pagerduty: PD: PD-98765 resolved (acknowledged -> mitigated).

oncall-amy: closing thread here, will keep the incident ticket open for RCA. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
